The new tests added for the replacement endpoints (`.add_members` and `.remove_member`) cover success and automatic-group rejection, but do not include equivalent “silent no-op” behavior coverage (e.g., `add_members` skips usernames when `User.find_by_username` returns nil; `remove_member` uses `group.users.delete(user_id)` which is likely a no-op if not present). This is a specific, diff-grounded test coverage gap for newly introduced endpoints rather than a verified functional defect.
